newsitem.title: USA: GM has fire at stamping plant.
newsitem.headline: GM has fire at stamping plant.

text.p: General Motors Corp was forced to evacuate 200 workers from a metal stamping plant Monday after a fire broke out in the facility's waxing operation.

The blaze broke out between 0800 and 0830 EDT Monday morning during the plant's first shift, said GM spokeswoman Rebecca Kirk. About 40 people worked directly in the area of the fire. There were no reports of injuries.

The plant employs 2,000 hourly workers who normally work three shifts. The facility produces frames for GM cars and trucks, although Kirk declined to be more specific about what vehicles get the products.
Kirk said production at the rest of the plant continued while firefighters contained the blaze.
GM officials were unavailable later Monday for comment on the extent of the damage.
